reason: B is the better testable proposal because Cu addition via HIP/annealing is more compatible with metallic HEA processing and directly compares high-temperature conductivity and mechanical/fatigue performance against a matched control. It remains materially under-specified and its claims of coherent, continuous nanoscale Cu pathways at 5 vol% and stability at 700°C are questionable, but A is less credible because 3–5 wt% graphene is difficult to disperse and bond, may react to form carbides, and can introduce large interfacial thermal resistance during 700–1000°C service.
